description.narrative: The Project contributes to the UNDP Regional Results Framework for Europe and the CIS 2022-2025, particularly Outcome 1 Structural transformation accelerated, particularly green, inclusive and digital transitions and Output 1.6 Innovation capabilities built, and approaches adopted to expand policy options at regional levels, and the UNDP Integrated Results and Resources Framework of the Strategic Plan 2022-2025. The two main components, BOOST and Strategic Innovation for Urban Systems, focus on building innovation capabilities, expanding policy options, and leveraging public and private finance for sustainable development at the regional level. BOOST programmes will create an enabling environment for innovation and systemic change, while Strategic Innovation for Urban Systems will develop and sustain transformative innovation and urban portfolios and mobilize public and private resources for sustainable urban development.

condition.narrative: Social and environmental sustainability will be enhanced through application of the UNDP Social and Environmental Standards (http://www.undp.org/ses) and related Accountability Mechanism (http://www.undp.org/secu-srm).

The Implementing Partner shall ensure that all of its obligations set forth under the section entitled “Legal Context and/or Risk Management Standard Clauses” are passed on to each responsible party, subcontractor and sub-recipient and that all the clauses under this section entitled “Risk Management” are included, mutatis mutandis, in all sub-contracts or sub-agreements entered into further to the Project Document
